0022600160.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-4, 12th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 7th in the East) in the Pacers' 8th game of the season, with Indiana on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 at home, while Atlanta enters on a one-game losing streak. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Obi Toppin (back soreness), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), all listed as out, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Jalen Johnson (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Pacers lost 1-2 to Atlanta in 2025-26, but the most recent meeting, on January 31, 2026 in Indianapolis, ended with an Indiana win, 129-124.
